create.name: Mary Sise
create.bio:
Licensed in New York State as a clinical social worker, Mary Sise has more than 35 years of clinical experience, and for over twenty years she has worked with energy psychology, a family of methods that combines focused attention with tapping on acupressure points. She is a former president of ACEP, the Association for Comprehensive Energy Psychology, holds its diplomate in comprehensive energy psychology and has presented at its annual conference for many years. With Sheila Sidney Bender she co-wrote The Energy of Belief.

At the centre of her teaching is her own form of Emotional Freedom Techniques (EFT), combining tapping, breath, intention and eye movements, together with meditation, sound and chakra work, with the aim of releasing limiting beliefs and living in line with the soul's guidance. The Soul Weaving Process, her later work, explores how split-off parts of the self can return to wholeness, and she directs the Magdalena Healing programme. She teaches recorded courses on her own site and The Shift Network, runs free weekly tapping groups, and offers a monthly mentorship for coaches, therapists and healers.

books.title: The Energy of Belief: Psychology's Power Tools to Focus Intention and Release Blocking Beliefs
books.author: Sheila Sidney Bender and Mary T. Sise
books.description: A practical guide to energy psychology and how beliefs held below conscious awareness shape everyday choices. The authors set out simple exercises that combine posture, breath and focused intention, illustrated with case stories from their practice.

courses.title: Aligning With Your Soul’s Guidance
courses.description: A 12-module course on telling the soul's guidance apart from fear, conditioning and inherited beliefs. Mary uses tapping and other energy psychology practices to quieten inner reactivity so that inner knowing can be recognised and acted on.

courses.title: Deep-Clearing EFT (Tapping)
courses.description: A seven-session self-paced course in Mary's own version of EFT, which joins a clear intention with breathing, tapping and eye movements. It looks at how old patterns and beliefs take hold and how to clear them so you can follow your soul's calling.

courses.title: Manifest What Your Soul Desires by Combining the Power of Energy Medicine & Spiritual Psychology
courses.description: A nine-module on-demand advanced course bringing together EFT, theta-state meditation, sound, breathwork and chakra clearing to work with subconscious blocks. It includes Mary's seven-module introductory tapping programme.

courses.title: Energy Psychology Mentorship
courses.description: An ongoing monthly mentorship for therapists, coaches and energy psychology practitioners. Members meet with Mary in a group to deepen their skills and discuss their work with clients.

courses.title: Calm in the Chaos
courses.description: A three-part recorded course on why we react strongly in tense moments and how tapping on the energy meridians can bring the body back to calm. It comes with downloadable videos and handouts.

courses.title: Love Without Limits: The Power of Authentic Connections
courses.description: A 90-minute recorded workshop on the energetics of genuine connection in relationships. It offers practices for opening the heart and sustaining loving, authentic bonds.

courses.title: Unlock Your Wealth
courses.description: A recorded workshop on the money beliefs, often inherited, that shape how we earn and receive. Mary uses tapping and reflection to help loosen patterns of scarcity and self-doubt.

free_resources.title: Tapping Tuesdays
free_resources.description: A free weekly online tapping group with Mary, held on Tuesdays at 2 p.m. Eastern time. Participants from around the world tap together to settle stress and learn a tool they can share with family and friends.

Instagram and Facebook counts couldn't be read; tier is based on YouTube only.
